title: UNCOVERING COMPETENCY GAPS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS AND THEIR BENCHMARKS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance and benchmark coverage on established bias datasets (BBQ and CrowS-Pairs) by extracting Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) concept activations and computing saliency-weighted performance scores.

Mapping cross-benchmark model performance scores into SAE concept spaces to identify a structural bias toward sycophantic, instruction-following behaviors compared to complementary concepts like polite refusals or asserting boundaries.
